purpose: Prove that Vera recovers the same key from a did:key that Soma committed to, and verifies a signature Soma produced. Vera and Soma implement base58btc, multicodec tagging and Ed25519 separately; porting an algorithm faithfully and agreeing byte-for-byte are different claims, and only the second one lets a Soma agent and a Vera observer be the same identity.
note: These are fixed values, not regenerated at test time. A test that generates its own input on both sides proves only that one implementation agrees with itself.

vectors.name: soma agent identity round-trips through vera

reject.name: opaque identifier commits to no key
reject.reason: not a did:key identifier; its key cannot be recovered

reject.name: did:key without multibase prefix
reject.reason: did:key fingerprint is not base58btc multibase
